contests.reason: Demo objection: filed to exercise the upper-bound (still-live) leg of standing against Bitcoin.

how: actor_sig covers the JCS of {v,recorder_id,event_type:"touchstone.contest",actor_sub:contestant,counterparty_sub:null,payload_hash,client_ts:null}; the cleartext body hashes to payload_hash. Two attestation grades: contestant-signed (contestant_pubkey present → verify actor_sig against it; grade verified iff that key is bound to the contestant sub at /pubkeys, else claimed) or server-attested (verify against server_pubkey — "Touchstone recorded that C contested T"). Either way, verify inclusion_proof → checkpoint.merkle_root → Bitcoin like any entry. "No contest" is trustworthy up to latest_checkpoint.seq_end; a contestant-signed contest also stays self-verifiable off-channel, so a refused/dropped one is detectable. standing-verify.py does the whole check.
